+title: Runner spec schema and loader for tool validators

+Add the `tool` validator kind. A validator set can hold a `runners/` directory. Each runner is one YAML file that binds one tool to one language.
+
+The contract is `builtin/validators/README.md`. Implement that spec exactly.
+
+Work:
+- Define one serde struct for the runner spec: name, project_types, file_extensions, scope (files|workspace), command, args, output (format, map, filter), exit.findings, doctor (check_command, check_version_command), install.commands, fixtures.
+- Mirror the `OwnedLspServerSpec` pattern and its YAML loader.
+- Load builtin runners with `include_dir!`. Do not hardcode file lists.
+- Resolve with the existing precedence: builtin < user (~/.validators/) < project (./.validators/).
+- Expose runners on `list validators` / `get validator` output.
+
+Acceptance:
+- A runner YAML in any of the three layers loads and resolves by precedence.
+- A malformed runner YAML reports one clear error and does not break the set.
+
+#tool-validators
\ No newline at end of file
